text: Bitcoin has gained modest ground on the day while Ethereum has lagged noticeably, suggesting risk appetite remains selective and traders are favoring the perceived safety of the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index sits at 22 with a slight upward shift, indicating the market is still in a state of deep uncertainty despite the small price advances. Bitcoin dominance holding at 56.3% with $61B in daily volume reflects cautious activity—enough liquidity to move prices but not conviction-driven buying across the board.
